title: Air Purifiers vs Plants
desc: Wondering if your home needs air purifiers? Contact the professionals at Rosenberg Indoor Comfort Specialists today in San Antonio, TX!

blocks.text: If you are looking for a way to make sure that you have cleaner and fresher air to breathe while you are inside your home, there are several ways to do it. Some of the most common options are actually having plants or putting an air purifier in your home. There are lots of benefits to having a way to purify your air and if you are trying to choose between the two, we can help you do exactly that.

Pros Plants are a great option to have in your home. Not only do they naturally help with air purification but they are also great additions to your decor. This is one of the best ways to help ensure you have cleaner air in your home. If you can take care of a plant and keep it alive. It is a great option for your home air purification.

Cons However, this does not come without some potential problems. Plants require care and not just once every month or so. You need to make sure you are properly taking care of your plants based on the needs fo the plant. Another negative aspect is that they sometimes attract bugs into your home. This is not always the case but it is not something you should be surprised about if you see a bug or two around the plant.

Pros An air purifier is something that you do not have to do a lot of maintenance on to make sure it keeps going. Since you do not need to take care of it once a day or a few times per week, it may be worth it to you, especially if you do not have a green thumb.

Cons However, it is a bit more expensive than plants tend to be. Another thing to note is that an air purifier does not serve well as additional decor in your home since it is a piece of equipment. However, it can get the job done just as well as plants do, just not in the more natural way.
